user.title: PTV – API Key
user.description: Enter your Transport Victoria Open Data API key and choose what to monitor. Add the integration again to monitor a second mode. Register at {portal_url}.

alerts.title: PTV – Service Alert Filters
alerts.description: Select which alert types should trigger your PTV sensors. Checked types will count as active alerts. Uncheck 'Other effect' and 'No effect' to ignore car park notices and informational updates.

station.title: PTV – Add Station{added}
station.description: Add a stop on {lines} to monitor. Tram stops include their stop number (e.g. "#115"). Select '(Done — no more stations)' when finished.

data.name: Station
data.count: Number of upcoming trains to track (1–4)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the PTV API.
error.no_alerts_selected: Select at least one alert type.
error.station_list_unavailable: Could not download the station list from Transport Victoria (the schedule file is large and the download may have timed out). Type your station name in manually, or go back and retry.

init.title: PTV – Polling Rates
init.description: Poll frequently during the commute peaks and slowly the rest of the time, to cut API usage. Times are local.

data.peak_on_weekends: Use peak rates on weekends too

error.empty_peak_window: A peak window's start and end cannot be the same time.
